entities.summary: James S. Albert is a professor of Biology at the University of Louisiana at Lafayette. Albert is an author of over 100 scientific papers on the evolution and diversity of fishes, and is an expert in the systematics and biodiversity of Neotropical electric fishes (Gymnotiformes). Albert and his colleagues to date have described 50 new species.
